title: Family in Winter Coats Outdoors, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A close-knit family outdoors during a cool season, likely late autumn or early spring. A woman rests on the grass wearing a thick wool winter overcoat with her hand tucked in her pocket. Behind her, a man crouches close, while a young child in a buttoned double-breasted coat and warm cap stands forward looking into the camera. Bare trees and a large public building or apartment block appear in the soft-focus background.
